info.title: Chess Backend API
info.description: REST API for the chess-backend-java project. WebSocket/STOMP is documented in README.md and is not covered by this spec.

tags.name: Friends
tags.description: Mutual request/accept friendships discovered by friend code.

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Invite accepted friends to a room you created.

tags.name: Rooms
tags.description: Create, join, and read chess rooms.

tags.name: Games
tags.description: Make moves and read game state.

post.description: Creates a new room with the caller as its single player. The caller's side comes from the optional preferredSide field (WHITE/BLACK/RANDOM; omitted defaults to WHITE; RANDOM is coin-flipped server-side). The response role reflects the resolved side, alongside the assigned playerId and the freshly generated roomId. The response also carries a secret joinToken (only the creator obtains it) that the opponent must supply to POST /api/rooms/{id}/join.

400.description: Invalid request (validation failure or malformed JSON)

post.description: Joins {id} as the second player and creates the game in the same atomic step. Requires the secret joinToken the creator obtained from the create response; a missing or wrong token returns 403 INVALID_JOIN_TOKEN (the roomId alone, used for watching, does not authorise joining). The joiner's role is the opposite of the side the creator chose at create time. Path {id} is case-insensitive; the canonical uppercase form is returned in the body.

400.description: Invalid request (validation failure or malformed JSON)

403.description: Missing or invalid join token for a token-protected room

get.description: Returns the caller's pending incoming invitations, filtered to still-live, still-joinable rooms (stale ones are pruned). Each entry carries the side the invitee would take and the room's time control, derived from the live room. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

200.description: The caller's live incoming invitations (possibly empty).

post.summary: Invite a friend to a room
post.description: Invites an ACCEPTED friend (by user id) to a FRIEND room the caller created. The invitee receives a real-time push on /user/queue/invitations if connected, and can also fetch it via GET /api/me/invitations. Re-sending the same (room, invitee) is idempotent (refresh, no error). Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

400.description: Invalid request (validation failure or malformed JSON).

403.description: NOT_ROOM_MEMBER — the caller is not a player of the room.

404.description: FRIEND_NOT_FOUND — friendUserId is not an accepted friend; or ROOM_NOT_FOUND — the room does not exist.

409.description: ROOM_FULL — the room has no free joinable slot (already full, or a bot room).

post.description: Accepts the invitation for {roomId}, joining the room as the second player. The join is performed server-side using the room's stored join token (never exposed to the client); the inviter learns of the join via the existing RoomJoinedEvent on /topic/rooms/{roomId}. Returns the joined room (roomId, playerId, role, gameId). Path {roomId} is case-insensitive. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

404.description: INVITATION_NOT_FOUND — no live invitation for the caller on that room.

409.description: ROOM_FULL — the room filled before the caller accepted.

post.summary: Send a friend request by friend code
post.description: Creates a PENDING friend request from the caller to the user owning the supplied friend code. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

400.description: Blank friend code (validation) or unparseable body.

404.description: FRIEND_CODE_NOT_FOUND — no user owns the supplied code.

409.description: ALREADY_FRIENDS (already an accepted friendship) or DUPLICATE_FRIEND_REQUEST (a pending request already exists in either direction).

422.description: SELF_FRIENDSHIP — the code is the caller's own.

post.description: Flips a PENDING request to ACCEPTED. Only the request's addressee may accept; any other caller — including the requester or one naming an unknown id — gets 404 with the same FRIEND_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND code (no existence leak). Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

404.description: FRIEND_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND — the request does not exist or the caller is not its addressee.

post.description: Applies a move on behalf of the caller (identified by the X-Player-Id header). The move is rejected if it is not the caller's turn, if the move is illegal in the current position, or if the game has already ended.

400.description: Invalid request (validation failure on body fields, malformed JSON body, malformed UUID in path or header, or missing X-Player-Id header)

422.description: Move is illegal or not the caller's turn

post.description: Creates a user with the given email + password (BCrypt-hashed) + display name and returns a freshly issued JWT. The token is immediately usable as the Authorization: Bearer header on subsequent authenticated requests — there is no separate confirmation step.

201.description: Account created; response carries the JWT and the user profile.

400.description: Validation failed (malformed email, missing field, password outside 8-72 chars, etc.).

409.description: An account with this email already exists.

post.summary: Log in with email and password
post.description: Validates the credentials and returns a freshly issued JWT. The failure response is uniform — wrong password and unknown email both surface as 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS with the same generic message, to avoid leaking which accounts exist.

200.description: Authenticated; response carries the JWT and the user profile.

get.description: Reads the current state of a room: the players (with roles derived from the creator's chosen side), the associated gameId if the room is ACTIVE, and the lifecycle status. The frontend uses this either as the primary discovery mechanism for Player A (poll until gameId is non-null) or as a fallback to STOMP /topic/rooms/{roomId} for late subscribers, which cannot replay events. Path {id} is case-insensitive; the canonical uppercase form is returned in the body.

200.description: Room exists; returns its current state

get.description: Returns archived (terminal-status) games for the given player, newest first, capped at 50 entries. An unknown player id returns 200 with an empty array — guests have no registry, so 404 is not used.

Returns the user identified by the Authorization: Bearer JWT. Requires a valid token issued by this backend; the response includes the user's id, canonical email, and display name. JWT issuance ships in feature 17; this endpoint is the validator side of the contract.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or unsigned-by-us JWT. Feature 17's AuthEntryPoint writes a structured ErrorResponse body with code AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED — the same envelope every other 4xx in the API uses.

get.summary: List the authenticated user's archived games
get.description: Returns the archived (terminal-status) games where the caller participated as either side, newest first, in the standard Spring Data Page envelope. Pagination params: page (default 0, min 0); size (default 20, min 1, max 100). Requires a valid Bearer JWT — anonymous requests get 401 AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. The page shape is the standard Spring Data envelope: { content, totalElements, totalPages, size, number, ... }.

400.description: Invalid pagination parameter (page < 0 or size outside [1, 100]).

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or unsigned-by-us JWT. Body is the standard ErrorResponse envelope with code AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED.

get.description: Paginated ACCEPTED friends, newest first, projecting each friend's live display name and friend code. Pagination: page (default 0, min 0); size (default 20, min 1, max 100). Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

400.description: Invalid pagination parameter (page < 0 or size outside [1, 100]).

get.description: Paginated PENDING requests where the caller is the requester, newest first. Same pagination contract as the friends list. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

400.description: Invalid pagination parameter (page < 0 or size outside [1, 100]).

get.description: Paginated PENDING requests where the caller is the addressee, newest first. Same pagination contract as the friends list. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

400.description: Invalid pagination parameter (page < 0 or size outside [1, 100]).

get.summary: Get the authenticated user's friend code
get.description: Returns the caller's stable, shareable 8-char friend code. Another user adds the caller as a friend by typing this code — there is no directory or search surface. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, or unsigned-by-us JWT.

get.description: Returns the application status, build version, and current server time.
Returns the current state of the game: position FEN, status, whose turn it is, the two players, and the full move history.

delete.description: The invitee declines the invitation for {roomId}; it is deleted and the inviter receives an InvitationDeclinedEvent on their user queue. Path {roomId} is case-insensitive. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

404.description: INVITATION_NOT_FOUND — no invitation for the caller on that room.

delete.description: The inviter cancels an invitation they sent to {inviteeUserId} for {roomId}; it is deleted and the invitee receives an InvitationCancelledEvent on their user queue. Path {roomId} is case-insensitive. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

403.description: NOT_ROOM_MEMBER — the caller is not a player of the room.

delete.description: Removes an ACCEPTED friendship with the user named by the path id. Either party may remove. Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

404.description: FRIEND_NOT_FOUND — no accepted friendship exists with that user.

delete.summary: Reject or cancel a pending friend request
delete.description: Deletes a PENDING request. The requester cancels their own outgoing request; the addressee rejects an incoming one — both delete the row (there is no REJECTED state, so re-requesting later is allowed). A non-participant or unknown id gets 404 FRIEND_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND (no existence leak). Requires a valid Bearer JWT.

404.description: FRIEND_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND — the request does not exist or the caller is not a participant.

preferredSide.description: The creator's requested side. WHITE or BLACK pin the creator's colour; RANDOM lets the server coin-flip it (the client cannot bias the result). Optional: omitting the field defaults to WHITE.

timeControl.description: Optional time control. When present, both sides start at initialMs and the server tracks the clock authoritatively, auto-flagging (status TIMEOUT) when the side to move runs out. Omit the field for an untimed game.

opponentKind.description: The opponent kind. FRIEND (the default when omitted) creates a room another human joins; BOT creates a complete game against the Stockfish engine immediately, so the response carries a non-null gameId and no joinToken.

botElo.description: Requested bot target strength as an Elo, relevant only when opponentKind=BOT. The server maps it to the engine's skill level (Fairy-Stockfish) rather than exposing a raw engine parameter. Must lie within 400-3190 (the ~400 floor stays reachable for true beginners). Omit the field to use the server's configured default strength.

initialMs.description: Starting clock per side, in milliseconds. Strictly positive.

incrementMs.description: Fischer increment added back to a player's clock after they move, in milliseconds. Zero for plain sudden-death.

roomId.description: 6-char short code from the alphabet ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789. Case-insensitive in URLs; canonical uppercase form returned here.

playerId.description: Server-generated UUID identifying the caller as a player in the room.

role.description: Side assigned to the caller. On create it is the creator's chosen side (WHITE by default, or BLACK / a RANDOM coin-flip result if requested); on join it is the opposite of the creator's side.

gameId.description: UUID of the chess game associated with the room. Null on the create response (no game exists yet); non-null on the join response.

joinToken.description: Secret join token required by POST /api/rooms/{id}/join. Non-null ONLY on the create response — the creator keeps it and shares it out-of-band with the opponent. Null on the join response, and never returned by GET /api/rooms/{id}. Possession of the roomId alone (used for watching) does not authorise joining.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by every 4xx response from the API.

error.description: Stable upper-snake-case error code identifying the error class. Intended for programmatic matching by clients.

joinToken.description: Secret join token obtained by the creator from the create response and shared out-of-band with the opponent. Required for rooms created after feature 22.7 shipped; a missing or wrong token returns 403 INVALID_JOIN_TOKEN.

roomId.description: Id of the FRIEND room the caller created and is inviting into. The caller must be a player of this room. Six-char short code.

friendUserId.description: User id of an ACCEPTED friend of the caller (from GET /api/me/friends). Must be an existing accepted friendship or the request is rejected 404 FRIEND_NOT_FOUND.

friendCode.description: The friend code of the user to send a request to.

from.description: Origin square in algebraic notation, lowercase.

to.description: Destination square in algebraic notation, lowercase.

promotion.description: Promotion piece for pawn promotion; one of KNIGHT, BISHOP, ROOK, QUEEN. Null otherwise.

turn.description: Side whose turn it is. WHITE if move count is even, BLACK if odd.

moves.description: Full move history in playback order.

whiteTimeRemainingMs.description: White's remaining clock in milliseconds, frozen at the last move. Null for an untimed game. The live value of the side to move is remaining - (now - lastMoveAt).

blackTimeRemainingMs.description: Black's remaining clock in milliseconds, frozen at the last move. Null for an untimed game.

lastMoveAt.description: Instant the side-to-move's clock started counting, ISO-8601 UTC. Null for an untimed game.

from.description: Origin square in algebraic notation, lowercase.

to.description: Destination square in algebraic notation, lowercase.

promotion.description: Promotion piece for pawn promotion; one of KNIGHT, BISHOP, ROOK, QUEEN. Null otherwise.

displayName.description: Display name provided at game start.

email.description: Account email; case-insensitive, normalised to lowercase server-side.

password.description: Plain-text password; 8-72 chars (72 is BCrypt's input cap — longer passwords would be silently truncated by the hash function).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

token.description: JWT to send on subsequent authenticated requests as Authorization: Bearer ...

id.description: Authenticated user's UUID; equal to the JWT 'sub' claim.

email.description: Canonical lowercase email associated with the account.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI.

email.description: Account email; case-insensitive, normalised to lowercase server-side.

displayName.description: Human-readable label provided at join time.

role.description: Side assigned to the player. WHITE for the creator (players[0]), BLACK for the joiner (players[1]).

RoomDetailsResponse.description: Current state of a room: members, derived roles, game association, status.

roomId.description: 6-char short code from the alphabet ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTUVWXYZ23456789. Case-insensitive in URLs; canonical uppercase form returned here.

players.description: Players in the room. Index 0 is the creator and holds the side they chose at create time; index 1 (when present) is the joiner and holds the opposite side. The array has 1 element while WAITING_FOR_PLAYER and 2 while ACTIVE.

gameId.description: UUID of the chess game associated with the room. Null while the room is WAITING_FOR_PLAYER (no game has been created yet); non-null once ACTIVE.

status.description: Lifecycle status. WAITING_FOR_PLAYER: one player, no game. ACTIVE: two players, game in progress. CLOSED: room no longer accepts activity.

selfRole.description: Side the queried player was on.

moveCount.description: Number of moves played in the game.

roomId.description: Room the invitation targets (6-char short code).

timeControl.description: The room's declared clock; null for an untimed room.

side.description: Side the invitee would take on accept (the opposite of the creator's side).

createdAt.description: When the invitation was created or last refreshed (ISO-8601 UTC).

roomId.description: Room id the game was played in.

opponentDisplayName.description: Audit-time display name of the opponent (frozen at game time; a later user-rename does not rewrite past games).

selfSide.description: Side the authenticated user was on.

moveCount.description: Number of moves played in the game.

MyGamesPage.description: Spring Data Page envelope for MyGameSummary entries. Carries the page contents plus the pagination metadata the frontend uses to render navigation controls.

content.description: Games on this page, newest first.

totalElements.description: Total number of games across all pages.

size.description: Page size that was requested (or the default).

first.description: True when this is the first page.

last.description: True when this is the last page.

numberOfElements.description: Number of entries on this page.

empty.description: True when this page is empty.

displayName.description: The friend's current display name (live, not a snapshot).

FriendsPage.description: Spring Data Page envelope for FriendResponse entries.

content.description: Friends on this page, newest first.

totalElements.description: Total number of friends across all pages.

first.description: True when this is the first page.

last.description: True when this is the last page.

numberOfElements.description: Number of entries on this page.

empty.description: True when this page is empty.

requestId.description: The request id; used to accept, reject, or cancel.

displayName.description: The other party's current display name (live, not a snapshot).

friendCode.description: The other party's shareable friend code.

FriendRequestsPage.description: Spring Data Page envelope for FriendRequestResponse entries.

content.description: Requests on this page, newest first.

totalElements.description: Total number of requests across all pages.

first.description: True when this is the first page.

last.description: True when this is the last page.

numberOfElements.description: Number of entries on this page.

empty.description: True when this page is empty.

friendCode.description: The caller's shareable friend code; 8 chars over an unambiguous alphabet.

status.description: Application liveness status; always "UP" when reachable.

version.description: Application build version, derived from BuildProperties at boot time.

timestamp.description: Server time at the moment the response was produced, in UTC.
